// Draws QDL's app icon. Usage: swift MakeIcon.swift out.png
import AppKit

let size: CGFloat = 1024
let out = CommandLine.arguments[1]

let rep = NSBitmapImageRep(bitmapDataPlanes: nil, pixelsWide: 1024, pixelsHigh: 1024,
                           bitsPerSample: 8, samplesPerPixel: 4, hasAlpha: true, isPlanar: false,
                           colorSpaceName: .deviceRGB, bytesPerRow: 0, bitsPerPixel: 0)!
NSGraphicsContext.saveGraphicsState()
NSGraphicsContext.current = NSGraphicsContext(bitmapImageRep: rep)

let shape = NSBezierPath(roundedRect: NSRect(x: 100, y: 100, width: 824, height: 824), xRadius: 185, yRadius: 185)

NSGraphicsContext.saveGraphicsState()
let shadow = NSShadow()
shadow.shadowColor = NSColor.black.withAlphaComponent(0.45)
shadow.shadowBlurRadius = 30
shadow.shadowOffset = NSSize(width: 0, height: -18)
shadow.set()
NSColor.black.setFill()
shape.fill()
NSGraphicsContext.restoreGraphicsState()

let gradient = NSGradient(starting: NSColor(srgbRed: 58 / 255, green: 46 / 255, blue: 140 / 255, alpha: 1),
                          ending: NSColor(srgbRed: 12 / 255, green: 10 / 255, blue: 28 / 255, alpha: 1))!
gradient.draw(in: shape, angle: -90)

let heights: [CGFloat] = [120, 210, 300, 380, 300, 210, 120]
let barWidth: CGFloat = 44
let gap: CGFloat = 30
let total = CGFloat(heights.count) * barWidth + CGFloat(heights.count - 1) * gap
let x0 = (size - total) / 2
let centerY = size - 440
for (i, h) in heights.enumerated() {
    let t = CGFloat(i) / CGFloat(heights.count - 1)
    let red = (120 + 135 * (1 - abs(t - 0.5) * 2)) / 255
    NSColor(srgbRed: red, green: (200 + 40 * t) / 255, blue: 1, alpha: 1).setFill()
    let x = x0 + CGFloat(i) * (barWidth + gap)
    NSBezierPath(roundedRect: NSRect(x: x, y: centerY - h / 2, width: barWidth, height: h),
                 xRadius: barWidth / 2, yRadius: barWidth / 2).fill()
}

let cx = size / 2
let ay = size - 690
let chevron = NSBezierPath()
chevron.move(to: NSPoint(x: cx - 120, y: ay))
chevron.line(to: NSPoint(x: cx, y: ay - 100))
chevron.line(to: NSPoint(x: cx + 120, y: ay))
chevron.lineWidth = 40
chevron.lineCapStyle = .round
chevron.lineJoinStyle = .round
NSColor.white.withAlphaComponent(0.94).setStroke()
chevron.stroke()

NSGraphicsContext.restoreGraphicsState()
try! rep.representation(using: .png, properties: [:])!.write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: out))
build.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Builds QDL.app and installs it into /Applications.
# Usage:  bash build.sh            (build + install + open)
#         bash build.sh --no-install
# UNIVERSAL=1 builds one app for both Apple Silicon and Intel (needs full Xcode, as on GitHub's Macs).
set -eo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

APP="QDL.app"

if ! xcrun --find swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Apple's Command Line Tools are needed to build the app."
  echo "A window will pop up — click Install, wait for it to finish, then run:  bash build.sh"
  xcode-select --install || true
  exit 1
fi

ARCH_FLAGS=""
if [[ "$UNIVERSAL" == "1" ]]; then ARCH_FLAGS="--arch arm64 --arch x86_64"; fi

echo "→ Compiling (first build takes a minute)…"
swift build -c release $ARCH_FLAGS
BIN_DIR="$(swift build -c release $ARCH_FLAGS --show-bin-path)"

ICONSET="Resources/AppIcon.iconset"
if [[ ! -f "$ICONSET/icon_512x512@2x.png" ]]; then
  echo "→ Drawing app icon…"
  mkdir -p "$ICONSET"
  swift Resources/MakeIcon.swift "$ICONSET/icon_512x512@2x.png"
  for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do
    sips -z "$s" "$s" "$ICONSET/icon_512x512@2x.png" --out "$ICONSET/icon_"$s"x"$s".png" >/dev/null
    if [[ "$s" != "512" ]]; then
      d=$((s * 2))
      sips -z "$d" "$d" "$ICONSET/icon_512x512@2x.png" --out "$ICONSET/icon_"$s"x"$s"@2x.png" >/dev/null
    fi
  done
fi

echo "→ Assembling $APP…"
rm -rf "$APP"
mkdir -p "$APP/Contents/MacOS" "$APP/Contents/Resources"
cp "$BIN_DIR/QDL" "$APP/Contents/MacOS/QDL"
cp Resources/Info.plist "$APP/Contents/Info.plist"
iconutil -c icns "$ICONSET" -o "$APP/Contents/Resources/AppIcon.icns"

echo "→ Signing locally…"
codesign --force --deep --sign - "$APP"

if [[ "$1" == "--no-install" ]]; then
  echo "✓ Built $(pwd)/$APP"
  exit 0
fi

echo "→ Installing to /Applications…"
rm -rf "/Applications/$APP"
cp -R "$APP" /Applications/
echo "✓ QDL is in your Applications folder."
open "/Applications/$APP"
